articles.title: An AI trade involving energy and infrastructure that's doubled your money, topping Nvidia
articles.description: If you put the same money into a basket of companies that are building out AI infrastructure and energy sources, you’ve done much better than stocks like Nvidia.

articles.title: Nvidia says it has ‘largely conceded’ China’s AI chip market to Huawei
articles.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company has "largely conceded" China's advanced artificial intelligence chip market to Huawei.

articles.title: Nvidia's latest record earnings fail to impress investors
articles.description: The chip giant reported more stellar results but its shares fell after-hours as investors wonder if it can keep up its pace of growth amid greater competition.
